title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Seeking the Pearl…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I notice her looking at a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One of my classmates said it's really difficult to win the Cuties from the machines here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, I love a good challenge, though. Let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: They're not easy to grab… but perhaps that's what makes it exciting…
choice_data_list: Let me show you some of my possibilities!
Let me show you some of my possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ooh… I like the way you're talking. Go ahead!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Tag in and swap places with me! Show me what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
